demos.description: Select use [virtual scroll](https://github.com/react-component/virtual-list) which get better performance, turn off it by setting `virtual={false}`.

demos.title: coordinate
demos.description: Coordinating the selection of provinces and cities is a common use case and demonstrates how selection can be coordinated. [Cascader](/components/cascader) component is strongly recommended in this case.
